business_summary: Sun Corporation engages in the global data intelligence, entertainment, information technology, and other businesses in Japan. the company operates through four segments: Global Data Intelligence Business, Entertainment- Related Business, IT-Related Business, and Wellness Business. It develops, manufactures, and sells mobile data transfer devices and mobile data solutions for law enforcement authorities. The company also offers IoT/M2M routers; cloud services, including platform that remote monitoring and control of factories, machinery, and agricultural equipment and IoT solutions that visualize remote conditions based on sensor information; and advanced remote support solutions using smart glasses; SunDMS, a device management service that enables centralized remote controls; and OKUDAKE-sensors. In addition, it provides game machine parts and game contents. Further, the company plans, develops, and manufactures amusement machines, including hardware to software to develop game machines. Sun Corporation was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
